title: A weakness has been identified in Edge0-AI Audio8_TTS up to 1d64afcc2da56222b41ddcf53de7b8bc54be1fb6. (CVE-2026-122159)
description: A path traversal weakness exists in Edge0-AI Audio8_TTS affecting the ArkTtsRuntime.__init__ function in the Model Path Resolution component. Manipulating the slow_decode_models argument can lead to unauthorized file path access. The vulnerability is remotely exploitable and public exploit code is available. The product uses a rolling release system, so specific affected versions are not disclosed. The project has been notified but has not yet responded or issued a fix.
